doc.description: live.step displays multiple sequences which have multiple steps composed of pitch, velocity, and duration. Two additional steps (Extra 1 and Extra 2) are available for user-defined display.

outlets.digest: Step Values (Index Pitch, Velocity, Duration, Extra1, Extra2)
